reasoning_content:
The issue: `${base}-install-complete.path` = `qisutu-daemon-install-complete.path` (wrong — it should be `qisutu-install-complete.path`). Instead, we need the instance ID derived from the service unit name: `qisutu-install-complete.service` → strip `-install-complete.service` → instance `qisutu`.

Rewrite oneshot_run:
```bash
oneshot_run() {
    # *-install-complete.service: enable the daemon, remove the temporary units
    local f unit instance svc
    unit="$1"
    instance="${unit%-install-complete.service}"
    f="$(unit_file "$unit")"
    svc="$(sed -n 's/.*systemctl enable --now \([^ ]*\).*/\1/p' "$f")"
    state_set "daemon-${svc%.service}" enabled
    start_daemon "$svc" || return 1
    state_set "path-${instance}-install-complete.path" inactive
    rm -f "/etc/systemd/system/${instance}-install-complete.path" "/etc/systemd/system/${instance}-install-complete.service"
    return 0
}
```

Also, fix path_active/path_deactivate: `grep -qF " path-$1=active"` — state_set saves as `key value` (two space-separated fields), so the state line is `path-qisutu-install-complete.path active`, but path_active is grepping for `path-...=active` (with an equals sign). This is also a mismatch! Fix:
```bash
path_active() { [ "$(state_get "path-$1")" = "active" ]; }
```

For clarity, I'll rewrite both functions entirely with a heredoc patch.

action.command:
cd /usr/local/bin && sed -i '/^oneshot_run() {$/,/^}$/c\
oneshot_run() {\
    # *-install-complete.service: enable daemon, remove temp units\
    local f unit instance svc\
    unit="$1"\
    instance="${unit%-install-complete.service}"\
    f="$(unit_file "$unit")"\
    svc="$(sed -n '"'"'s/.*systemctl enable --now \\([^ ]*\\).*/\\1/p'"'"' "$f")"\
    state_set "daemon-${svc%.service}" enabled\
    start_daemon "$svc" || return 1\
    state_set "path-${instance}-install-complete.path" inactive\
    rm -f "/etc/systemd/system/${instance}-install-complete.path" "/etc/systemd/system/${instance}-install-complete.service"\
    return 0\
}\
\
path_active() { [ "$(state_get "path-$1")" = "active" ]; }' systemctl
bash -n systemctl && echo SYNTAX_OK && sed -n '/^oneshot_run/,/^}/p' systemctl && grep -n "path_active\|path_deactivate" systemctl | head
